assessment.shape_scope: Required evaluation inputs; preparation specification, not an admitted Workload Contract.
assessment.abi_and_semantics: BF16 Q/K/V/G/beta and state; FP32 A_log/dt_bias; D=128; in-kernel Q/K L2 norm, gate and sigmoid beta; finite negative lower_bound; scale=1/sqrt(128). Include fixed and packed offsets, output, final state and state-pool preservation. No conv/RMSNorm wrapper substitution.
assessment.correctness: Public FlashKDA comparison uses atol=rtol=1e-2 on every output/state element; the paper bitwise statement is not this peer gate. Freeze reference rounding and both output/state obligations before running.
mechanisms: Persistent recurrent state across 32-token chunks with TMEM residency.
Overlapped preparation, TMA, MMA, compute and epilogue roles with a five-slot pipeline.
M64 only for fixed B=1,H=64; M128 otherwise; packed sequence ordering.
Exact-full-range state alias and direct in-place update; reject partial overlap.
next_steps: New prefill contract, independent recurrence oracle and authoring route.
Cross-chunk state lifecycle and exact alias support in the selected lowering.
Six-shape public API baseline adapter and graph/stream/state reset coverage.
assessment.performance_criterion: Unselected: bind the external baseline, criterion and budget before measurements; report ratios without a parity claim until then.

T2/T4 WY-style schedules and T5/T6 coefficient-Gram plus triangular residual solve.

All T checkpoint states, accepted-token selection and padded/invalid state slots.

Registered task starter and stateful authoring/evaluation integration.
Qualify 30 public API rows plus low-wave dispatch branches; headline T5/T6 rows exercise split1 only.

assessment.shape_scope: Required evaluation inputs; preparation specification, not an admitted Workload Contract.

mechanisms: Four-stage versus eight-stage shared-memory rings and explicit loader/compute roles.
Shallow when K<=1024 or CTA grid>2*SM count; freeze shape crossover before reporting.
PDL on/off with programmatic stream serialization.
Batch 1..7 TMA zero fill and masked output; preserve accumulator/reduction ordering.
next_steps: The B300 typed candidate passed 30/30 development bitwise checks over the three declared shapes and five distributions; authoring starts from the B1/N128/K720 seed and each Campaign requalifies its compiled baseline.
Preserve independent PDL, faithful TMA/warp partition, dispatch, performance and framework gates; numerical equality does not close them.
Obtain the original 35/239-row manifests before claiming their coverage; benchmark the other two frozen shapes through explicit cells.
